mechanism: Dexamethasone may mask ototoxicity and nephrotoxicity symptoms from amikacin while increasing infection risk through immunosuppression; amikacin's aminoglycoside nephrotoxicity is enhanced by concurrent corticosteroid use.
action: Monitor renal function and hearing closely; use lowest effective corticosteroid dose; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antibiotics if possible; baseline and periodic audiometry recommended.
